costlyMisconceptions.description: Thinks the seasons happen because Earth is closer to the Sun in summer and farther in winter.
costlyMisconceptions.beliefStatement: It is summer when Earth is closer to the Sun, and winter when it is farther away.
costlyMisconceptions.correction: The tilt of Earth's axis causes the seasons. Earth is actually closest to the Sun in early January, in the middle of Northern Hemisphere winter.

materialRef.quote: Earth is closest to the Sun in early January, during Northern Hemisphere winter.
